title: Madhava of Sangamagrama
lineage: Provider-rendered source passages inspected; local file contains paraphrased notes rather than original source text.

passages.note: Biography: Madhava’s mathematical writings are lost; later Kerala authors attribute series to him. Jyesthadeva’s Yuktibhasa dates to around 1550 and describes a series for an arc, equivalent in modern notation to arctangent expansion. Dating is approximate and attribution is mediated.
